Name: Final Pam
Author: magemeows
Description:
[size=3]A dumb mod to make Pam look like the Final Pam from Polygon's Monster Factory series.

If you have Platonymous's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999/?]Portraiture mod[/url], the portraits can be used through smapi. The sprites cannot be used through smapi, and must be downloaded as an xnb. The portraits are also available in xnb.

[/size][color=#ff0000][size=3]Smapi Instructions:[/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=3]Have both smapi and the portraiture mod linked above[/size]
[*][size=3]download the SMAPI portrait file[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip the file[/size]
[*][size=3]Go to the Stardew Valley main file > mods > portraiture > portraits[/size]
[*][size=3]place the png into the portraits file[/size]
[*][size=3]in-game, talk to a character and press "P" to change the portrait[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[color=#ff0000]xnb instructions:[/color]
[list]
[*][size=3]Back up your vanilla Stardew Valley files. The files that will be replaced are named "pam" under Stardew Valley > Content > Portraits; and Stardew Valley > Content > Characters. Save the vanilla files somewhere you can easily find them. This is in case something goes wrong, or when you inevitably want the vanilla Pam back[/size]
[*][size=3]Download the xnb files for both the portraits and the sprites[/size]
[*][size=3]Unzip the files[/size]
[*][size=3]Drop the portrait xnb into Stardew Valley > Content > Portraits. Do the same with the sprite xnb, but place it under "characters"[/size]
[*][size=3]Let my files override the vanilla files[/size]
[*][size=3]Enjoy! Or. Not.[/size]
[/list][/size]
[size=4][color=#6d9eeb]UPDATE:[/color]
[/size][size=3]I touched up the portraits, so they have more shadowing and look less flat. Same deal as before, they'll be available as both a SMAPI mod and an xnb file. They're labelled as "V.2".

Also, I am working on Final Pam dialogue. It's pretty rough right now, so I'm still working out the kinks. Once it's polished enough, I'll add it on here.

I also just recently got the bus running in my town; I realized that she looks like the vanilla Pam when she gets on the bus. Sometime soon I plan on editing the bus sprite so that this doesn't happen anymore.

And thanks again for all of the support and suggestions!![/size]
